speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a complex history; to guide my examination, could you describe exactly how your gait and limb coordination have been affected, and when these symptoms first began?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like significant cerebellar dysfunction. Have you noticed any speech difficulties like slurring, or changes in your vision such as double vision since the symptoms started?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

Please confirm if you have noticed any changes in your personality, mood, or memory in addition to your motor and speech issues. Also, I need to review your latest MRI results immediately: REQUEST TEST: Brain_MRI_with_contrast.
